poll_interval.label: Poll interval (s)
poll_interval.description: How often to read the keyboard's battery levels

low_threshold.label: Low battery (%)
low_threshold.description: A half at or below this turns red and sends a notification

critical_threshold.label: Critical battery (%)
critical_threshold.description: A second, urgent notification at or below this

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Notify when a half reaches the low or critical level

show_value.label: Show values
show_value.description: Print the percentages next to the meters

notify.body: Battery at {level}%. Charge the keyboard soon.
